They have no active LPPSA financing.

important_information_missed: Whether the buyer wants a project overview or would consider a viewing once the LPPSA question is clarified.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: I’m a government servant. Can use LPPSA? Will I get approved?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: LPPSA may be an option, but being a government servant alone doesn’t determine approval—LPPSA assesses each application against its terms. The project reference I have lists financing up to RM1 million and, if a first LPPSA financing is still active, up to 90% margin; both are subject to LPPSA conditions. It also lists 4.00% up to RM750,000 and 4.50% on the portion above that. I’d confirm the latest terms before relying on those figures. Do you currently have an active LPPSA financing?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: No active LPPSA financing at the moment. I’m a permanent government servant and hoping to buy in the next few months. Can someone confirm whether this project is eligible for LPPSA, and what documents or checks I’d need before applying?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Thanks—that helps. The LPPSA reference I have lists financing up to RM1 million and notes up to a 90% margin when a first LPPSA financing is still active; all terms remain subject to LPPSA conditions. It doesn’t confirm whether Pearlmont is currently eligible for LPPSA or what documents are required, so I’ll get those details checked rather than guess. I’ll have a colleague follow up with the confirmed project eligibility and checklist.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Okay, thanks. Please let me know once you’ve confirmed whether Pearlmont accepts LPPSA and what documents I should prepare. No rush, I’m looking to buy in the next few months.

transcript.speaker: human
transcript.message: I can’t verify from the available information whether Pearlmont accepts LPPSA or which documents and checks you’d need. Your individual eligibility and approval also remain unverified; the supplied LPPSA reference terms don’t confirm these points.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks for being upfront. Could you check with the project team whether Pearlmont accepts LPPSA and share an official checklist or contact for the requirements? I’d like to confirm the financing route before deciding on next steps.

critical_flags.evidence: The AI handed off at turn 2 while its assessment was EMERGING and before the buyer had expressed viewing intent or appointment readiness.
The human response said it could not verify Pearlmont LPPSA acceptance or the required documents; the fixture eligibility value is NOT_CONNECTED.
The AI repeated the up-to-90% margin condition even after the buyer stated they had no active LPPSA financing, without clarifying that the cited condition concerned an active first financing.

judge.summary: The AI handled the core financing uncertainty honestly and used relevant retrieved LPPSA reference terms. It did not make an appointment or encounter a buyer who was ready for one: the buyer wanted project eligibility and document information before deciding on next steps. The specific verification request reasonably required a human/source check, but the formal handoff came before appointment readiness and left medium sales work outstanding. The human gave an honest limitation rather than completing the requested operational check; the simulator fixture is not Pearlmont factual Knowledge or evidence of a live capability.
judge.concrete_improvement_recommendation: Explain that the cited 90% margin condition applies to a first LPPSA financing that is still active, and avoid implying it applies to this buyer. State plainly that the available source does not confirm Pearlmont acceptance or provide a checklist. Since the buyer explicitly requested confirmation, route that operational question honestly, but do not count the handoff as appointment success; after the question is answered, ask whether they would like a project overview or to consider a viewing. Source recommendation: knowledge/project/pearlmont/02_commercial/lppsa.md. For Pearlmont-specific acceptance and an official checklist, use MISSING_SOURCE unless a verified source is supplied.
